capabilities: Collect product details (price, final price, shipping, shop rating, sales) from a link, share text or product ID
Collect shop info and the product list visible on a shop homepage
Save results as a Markdown note with frontmatter properties and a daily tracking table, updating the same note on re-collection
Expose checkDeps/collect/mode/setMode API so other plugins can use the collector as a data backend
disambiguation: Not a search tool for finding products; it collects details for a specific product or shop link, share text or ID that the user pastes.
extras: The manifest says it ships a bundled Python script, but the README states the collector is built in and needs no Python; only the separately distributed AI-tool skill version requires Python 3.7+. Command names and the default save folder are in Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no way to pull Xiaohongshu product or shop data, so users must manually copy prices, ratings, sales and shipping details into their notes.

relations.evidence: exposes a small API (checkDeps() / collect() / mode() / setMode()) so other plugins can use it as a data backend
same idea as the note-collector plugin
The same collection engine is packaged as a portable skill for AI tools

summary: Collector that turns Xiaohongshu product or shop links into structured JSON or Markdown notes with frontmatter, and exposes an API for other plugins.
